headline: Fair: eighty percent of checks in and only four quiet stations. One to watch below Clarrie Hall Dam, where the dam gauge beside it is talking fine.

scenes.title: Good morning
scenes.say: Good morning. The Know-It-All here, and as I predicted, a fair day. Eighty percent of checks came in, up from seventy-five, and we heard over twelve hundred stations. Only four that keep a schedule are quiet.

scenes.title: A small low over the Tweed
scenes.sub: one gauge quiet beside a busy one
scenes.say: The one that stands out is the gauge below Clarrie Hall Dam: thirty-four reports the day before, four in the last day, the last at 11:17 on Friday morning. The dam gauge beside it got a hundred and three through, so the area's path works. That points at the station itself: power, radio or aerial. On the Gold Coast, Stewarts Road and Natural Bridge are quiet again.

scenes.title: The week so far
scenes.say: Here's the week. Checks received bottomed out at sixty-three percent on Tuesday, with the Lockyer and Hillcrest both out, and climbed back to seventy-nine by Friday. Both repeaters are still talking today: Toowoomba sent ten reports, Hillcrest six.

scenes.title: Our end of the line
scenes.say: Alex Chen on the radio. Both receivers ran all day, no settings changed, and the noise floor is steady. Our busiest channel carried sixty-eight thousand bursts on Friday, double early in the week, now the Lockyer's back. 152.400 still isn't being listened to.

scenes.title: Batteries
scenes.say: The New Recruit. Is it supposed to do that? Bundamba School sat at 13.2 volts for five nights, then 9.1, then 9.5. Two low nights in a row makes a bad reading less likely. It's still reporting. Kunghur stays at 9.5, Dunbible Creek at 9.8.

items.name: Dunbible Creek at Dunbible Creek Rail Trail Bridge

scenes.title: Check signals
scenes.say: Turbo, quick lap! Blackstone Bridge, Bray Park Weir and Priestdale missed every check in the period. Personal best for Kingsholme, sadly: forty-eight in a row.

scenes.title: Worth a look today
scenes.say: So, worth a look: the gauge below Clarrie Hall Dam, Bundamba School's battery, and Kingsholme. And good news: a hundred and six stations the server had called silent were heard again.

items.text: Clarie Hall Dam D/S: 4 reports in a day, last 11:17 am Friday; the dam gauge beside it is fine.
Bundamba School AL: 9.1 V then 9.5 V after steady 13.2 V.
Kingsholme: 48 checks missed in a row.
Heard again: 106 stations the server had called silent.

scenes.title: That’s the network
scenes.say: That's the network: fair, and getting fairer. I knew it would. Back tomorrow.

caveats: The per-stick figures show about seventy stations a few decibels weaker, but the channel's median signal and noise floor held steady, so it is left out.
Bundamba School's power could not be checked beyond its own battery reports.
author: Claude Code, from the bulletin draft and read-only queries
